name: delivrie
label: Delivrie
description: Send email, sync contacts and start automations with Delivrie, and react to deliveries, bounces, received mail and the Inbox.

modules.name: watchEvents
modules.label: Watch Events
modules.description: Triggers on the Delivrie events you choose.

modules.name: sendEmail
modules.label: Send an Email
modules.description: Sends an email from a verified domain, or a published template.

modules.name: upsertContact
modules.label: Create or Update a Contact
modules.description: Adds a contact or updates the one with this email.

modules.name: addToSegment
modules.label: Add Contacts to a Segment
modules.description: Adds contacts to a segment, creating any that don't exist.

modules.name: sendEvent
modules.label: Send an Event
modules.description: Records an event that starts automations.

modules.name: makeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Calls any Delivrie API endpoint with your connection.
